items.prompt: After a lower-bound search returns position n, which action prevents an out-of-range read?

options.text: Test position<n before accessing the ladder.
options.why: The sentinel denotes no element, so only valid positions may be dereferenced.

options.text: Read prices[n], then check whether the value is large enough.
options.why: The read is already out of range before that check.

options.text: Replace n by n-1 and report that price as qualifying.
options.why: The last price may still be below the query.

options.text: Append a fake price to the supplied input in place.
options.why: That changes the immutable ladder and its declared domain.
